profile.headline: Lead ServiceNow Engineer

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Technology Leadership · Leading Development Teams

positions.title: ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
Developed custom service portal widgets, flow designer flows, and API integrations
Lead development of technical governance and processes to implement citizen developer program for implementation of catalog builder
Lead adoption of Automated Testing Framework 
Created reports and dashboards utilizing performance analytics
Implemented API integrations and REST web services with internal and external applications

positions.title: ServiceNow Administrator
positions.description:
Designed and developed custom Service Portal widgets, catalog item icons, portal pages, email templates and mail scripts utilizing AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, and Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop
Lead project management of HR Service Catalog by training business stakeholders in agile kanban methodology and facilitating requirements gathering utilizing ServiceNow visual taskboard
Lead development of HR Service Catalog items, custom applications, and process automations using flow designer

positions.title: ETL Developer
positions.description:
• Developed data integration programs using Informatica suite, MarkLogic, Denodo Data Virtualization Platform, and SQL Server
• Worked as part of a 24x7 team performing Informatica administration
• Provided Tier 3 Support and resolution of open IT issues
• Created ServiceNow reports and dashboards to improve team's incident response rate

positions.title: Application Support Specialist Tier 2
positions.description:
• Quickly and effectively diagnosed and resolved enterprise application and Salesforce.com CRM software issues that are escalated by the Tier 1 support desk.
• Utilized understanding of relational databases and Standard Query Language (SQL) to generate reports for end users
• Fully documented each issue and resolution using ServiceNow incident management and knowledge base
• Communicated and coordinated tasks with peers and management across multiple departments

positions.title: Internet Service Consultant
positions.description:
•	Provided technical support for email, hosting, and web products to small business owners
•	Consulted with customers to recommend products and services based on their business needs

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Wrote regular expressions and scripts to facilitate search of key variable names throughout documentation
•Rectified discrepancies between software code and documentation utilizing IBM Rational Doors
•Conducted data-coupling analysis of embedded avionics software in compliance with FAA requirements
•Wrote scripts to conduct automated unit tests of Ada software modules

positions.title: Lending Risk Analyst I
positions.description:
•	Analyzed existing credit card accounts to determine credit worthiness 
•	Investigated credit profiles to identify first-party fraud, account take-overs, money laundering and synthetic identities 
•	Mentored peers as a resource for knowledge of business practices and procedures
•	Awarded “2013 Top Performer”

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
•Graphic design and printing services
•Packing, shipping, and international shipping
•Notary Public 
•Cash-Handling
•Cross-selling and up-selling

positions.title: Advertising Exec Jr
positions.description: Sold Advertising in daily newspaper, coupon book, and website to local and national business by communicating with business owners and marketing directors and increasing customer base.

positions.title: Vice President of Administration -Arizona State University
positions.description: •Lead executive board in completion of Chapter Excellence Report in order facilitate communication with International Head Quarters leading to ranking in top 10 chapters
